articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin cuts losses as stocks edge higher
articles.snippet: Oil quickly plunged, but then reversed higher, on conflicting reports about the state of the war in Iran.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
articles.snippet: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.snippet: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

articles.title: Drift exploiter sends $61M ETH to Tornado Cash, holds $194M
articles.snippet: The April 1 hack caused about $295 million in losses and was later attributed to a North Korean threat group in a Mandiant investigation.
